{{dablink|For other uses of the word "white," see [[White]].}}
The '''''Whitecap''''' is a ship of the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Whitecap}}

==Activities==
The ''Whitecap'' was the ship that was tasked with bringing food to [[Bandar Eban]] under the [[Bargains of the Atha'an Miere#The Bargain with the Coramoor|Bargain]] between the ''Atha'an Miere'' and their [[Coramoor]], [[Rand al'Thor]]. The [[Sailmistress]], [[Milis din Shalada Three Stars]], brings her ship into Bandar Eban, but [[Iralin]] refuses to allow them to unload the grain due to spoilage.{{ref/book|12|42}}{{ref/book|13|25}} After [[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 50|Rand's transformation]], he returns to Bandar Eban and finds that the dockworkers only opened the spoiled grain and that the rest of the sacks contain fresh grain.{{ref/book|13|25}}

==Crew==
*Milis din Shalada Three Stars - Sailmistress
